snippet.title: Misspell - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Misspell is a 2D atmospheric Metroidvania about magic and mysteries of the past. Uncover the secrets of an island risen from the ashes of a catastrophe and master a living vine that changes the way you fight and explore. Every step tells a story — every enemy echoes the mistakes of the past.

Watch the official gameplay trailer and discover a mysterious island filled with ancient ruins, secrets, and dangers.

👉 Add Misspell to your Steam wishlist and follow the game on itch.io!
